title: Typed lower-shriek counits on polynomial-presentation sites
statement:
Let $A\to B\to C$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings. Choose a common infinite cardinal bound containing the three rings and all variable sets used below, and small skeletons in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal C_{T/S}$ be the opposite category of polynomial $S$-algebras $P$ with an $S$-algebra map $P\to T$; a morphism in the non-opposite category is an $S$-algebra map commuting with these augmentations. Let $\mathcal E=\mathcal C_{C/B/A}$ be the opposite category of pairs $U=(P\to B,Q\to C)$, with $P$ polynomial over $A$, $Q$ polynomial over $P$, and $Q\to C$ compatible with $P\to B\to C$; morphisms before taking opposites are pairs of compatible $A$-algebra maps $P\to P'$, $Q\to Q'$ commuting with both augmentations and with $P\to Q$. Put $\mathcal C_1=\mathcal C_{B/A}$, $\mathcal C_2=\mathcal C_{C/A}$, $\mathcal C_3=\mathcal C_{C/B}$. Give all four categories the identity-cover topology, so sheaves are presheaves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Define
$$u_1(U)=(P\to B),\quad u_2(U)=(Q\to C),\quad u_3(U)=(Q\otimes_P B\to C).$$
Their action on morphisms is the induced algebra map, with arrows reversed; $Q$ is polynomial over $A$ and $Q\otimes_P B$ is polynomial over $B$. On $\mathcal C_i$ write $\mathcal O^{(i)}$ for the ring presheaf sending a presentation to its polynomial algebra, $R_1=B$, $R_2=R_3=C$, and $\mathcal O^{(i)}\to\underline{R_i}$ for its augmentation. The induced geometric morphism $g_i:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal E)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C_i)$ has inverse image precomposition with $u_i$, direct image its right adjoint. Its inverse image is exact on module presheaves with pulled-back rings. Put $\mathcal O_i=g_i^{-1}\mathcal O^{(i)}$; explicitly their values at $U$ are $P,Q,Q\otimes_P B$. The variable-structural-ring morphism $g_i^{\mathrm{str}}:(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal E),\mathcal O_i)\to(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C_i),\mathcal O^{(i)})$ has identity structural map $g_i^{-1}\mathcal O^{(i)}=\mathcal O_i$ [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. The augmentations $\mathcal O_i\to\underline{R_i}$ are the displayed maps to $B,C,C$; the additional coefficient map is $\underline B\to\underline C$.
For any commutative coefficient ring $R$, separately let $g_i^R:(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal E),\underline R)\to(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C_i),\underline R)$ have identity structural map. Write $\pi^R,\pi_i^R$ for the constant-coefficient morphisms to $(*,R)$, with constant inverse images, so $\pi^R=\pi_i^R g_i^R$. All modules are sheaves of left modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The constant-coefficient $g_{i,!}^R$ is left Kan extension along $u_i^{op}$, i.e. the left adjoint to precomposition, and $Lg_{i,!}^R$ is its total left derived functor on $D(\underline R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; $L\pi_!^R$ is derived colimit as in [lem-trf-derived-colimit-bar]. The adjunction counits
$$Lg_{i,!}^R g_i^{-1}K\longrightarrow K\quad(i=1,2,3)$$
are isomorphisms for every module presheaf $K$ on $\mathcal C_i$ in degree zero. Consequently the canonical maps
$$c_i(K):L\pi_!^R(g_i^{-1}K)\longrightarrow L\pi_{i,!}^R K$$
are isomorphisms in $D(R)$, natural in $K$. Their bar representatives are exactly $(U_n\to\cdots\to U_0,x)\mapsto(u_iU_n\to\cdots\to u_iU_0,x)$ from [lem-trf-derived-colimit-bar]. The same claims hold for abelian presheaves with $R=\mathbf Z$. These comparisons concern constant-coefficient module categories; the variable structural rings above specify the differential sheaves and their augmentation actions.
